Package pt.pa.ui.resources

Class AbstractResourceBundleManager

java.lang.Object
pt.pa.ui.resources.AbstractResourceBundleManager
Direct Known Subclasses:
FXMLResourceBundle, StringsResourceBundle
public abstract class AbstractResourceBundleManager extends Object
Abstract base class for managing resource bundles with support for multiple locales. Provides common functionality for updating locales, retrieving strings, and managing resource bundles shared across different implementations (JavaFX and FXML).
